test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 03 Dec, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it seems to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

**statement:**

Some rats are bats.

Some bats are cats.

**conclusion:**

I. All cats are rats.

II. Some bats are rats.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5dca0ddc7ac45d4b94df8a5942dcac195baddebca1c830146c9363c997529bd.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All cats are rats → Does not follow (As some rats are bats and some bats are cats. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some bats are rats → Follow (As some rats are bats. As some part of rats is common with bats, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
